✅ Fixed Issues

  • Hour hand position: Now correctly positioned just slightly past 10 (not halfway to 11)
  • Color scheme: Changed to HPC/Supercomputer theme with dark slate face and electric cyan accents
  • Hand ratio: Hour hand is ~50% length of minute hand (proper proportion)

Design Features

  • Dark slate → charcoal gradient background
  • Electric cyan hands with gradient (#00d4ff → #0099cc)
  • Cyan glow effects on hour markers
  • Professional HPC/tech aesthetic
  • Pixelated style = discrete event simulation

📝 Implementation

The logo has been integrated into Sphinx documentation:

  • docs/conf.py updated with logo paths
  • Logo will appear in top-left of documentation when built
  • Favicon configured for browser tabs

To rebuild documentation:

cd docs
make clean
make html
open _build/html/index.html
